name: Textlite PX1000 C SIP
author: filip@fkomarek.eu
description: Answers incoming SIP calls over UDP and plays dynamic shell-command output encoded as TEXT LITE PX1000 C FSK audio (300, 600, or 1200 baud).

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

REPO="filip2cz/textlite-px1000c"
PJSIP_VERSION="2.16"
VERSION="${VERSION:-latest}"

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl jq ca-certificates

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64|amd64)
        ARCH="x64"
        ;;
    i386|i686)
        ARCH="x86"
        ;;
    aarch64|arm64)
        ARCH="aarch64"
        ;;
    armv7l|armhf)
        ARCH="armv7l"
        ;;
    armv5*|armel)
        ARCH="armv5te"
        ;;
    riscv64)
        ARCH="riscv64"
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Unsupported architecture: $(uname -m)" >&2
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

downloaded=0
if [[ "$VERSION" != "main" ]]; then
    if [[ "$VERSION" == "latest" ]]; then
        RELEASE_URL="https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO}/releases/latest"
    else
        RELEASE_URL="https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO}/releases/tags/${VERSION}"
    fi

    RELEASE_JSON="$(curl -fsSL -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' "$RELEASE_URL" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if [[ -n "$RELEASE_JSON" ]]; then
        SIP_URL="$(printf '%s' "$RELEASE_JSON" | jq -r --arg name "sip-linux-${ARCH}" '.assets[]? | select(.name == $name) | .browser_download_url' | head -n 1)"
        ENC_URL="$(printf '%s' "$RELEASE_JSON" | jq -r --arg name "encode-linux-${ARCH}" '.assets[]? | select(.name == $name) | .browser_download_url' | head -n 1)"
        DEC_URL="$(printf '%s' "$RELEASE_JSON" | jq -r --arg name "decode-linux-${ARCH}" '.assets[]? | select(.name == $name) | .browser_download_url' | head -n 1)"
        if [[ -n "$SIP_URL" && -n "$ENC_URL" && -n "$DEC_URL" ]]; then
            echo "Downloading prebuilt linux-${ARCH} binaries from GitHub release..."
            curl -fsSL "$SIP_URL" -o /mnt/server/sip
            curl -fsSL "$ENC_URL" -o /mnt/server/encode
            curl -fsSL "$DEC_URL" -o /mnt/server/decode
            chmod +x /mnt/server/sip /mnt/server/encode /mnt/server/decode
            downloaded=1
        fi
    fi
fi

if [[ "$downloaded" -eq 0 ]]; then
    REF="$VERSION"
    if [[ "$REF" == "latest" ]]; then
        REF="main"
    fi
    echo "No matching published release found for '${VERSION}' (linux-${ARCH}); building from source (${REF})..."
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential pkg-config tar make

    rm -rf /tmp/textlite-src /tmp/pjsip /tmp/pjproject.tar.gz
    mkdir -p /tmp/textlite-src
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 "https://github.com/${REPO}/archive/${REF}.tar.gz" -o /tmp/textlite-src/src.tar.gz
    tar -xzf /tmp/textlite-src/src.tar.gz -C /tmp/textlite-src --strip-components=1

    curl -fsSL --retry 3 "https://github.com/pjsip/pjproject/archive/refs/tags/${PJSIP_VERSION}.tar.gz" -o /tmp/pjproject.tar.gz
    chmod +x /tmp/textlite-src/.github/scripts/build_pjsip.sh
    /tmp/textlite-src/.github/scripts/build_pjsip.sh \
        --tarball /tmp/pjproject.tar.gz \
        --prefix /tmp/pjsip \
        --cc gcc \
        --cxx g++ \
        --cflags "-O2 -std=gnu99"

    cd /tmp/textlite-src
    gcc -std=c11 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror decode.c -lm -o /mnt/server/decode
    gcc -std=c11 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror encode.c -lm -o /mnt/server/encode

    PJSIP_CFLAGS="$(PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/tmp/pjsip/lib/pkgconfig pkg-config --static --cflags libpjproject)"
    PJSIP_LIBS="$(PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/tmp/pjsip/lib/pkgconfig pkg-config --static --libs libpjproject | sed 's/-lstdc++//g')"
    gcc -std=c11 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror $PJSIP_CFLAGS sip.c $PJSIP_LIBS -pthread -o /mnt/server/sip
    chmod +x /mnt/server/sip /mnt/server/encode /mnt/server/decode

    cd /mnt/server
    rm -rf /tmp/textlite-src /tmp/pjsip /tmp/pjproject.tar.gz
fi

cat <<'EOF' > /mnt/server/start.sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

ARGS=(
    --registrar "${SIP_REGISTRAR:?SIP_REGISTRAR is required}"
    --identity "${SIP_IDENTITY:?SIP_IDENTITY is required}"
    --username "${SIP_USERNAME:?SIP_USERNAME is required}"
    --command "${SIP_COMMAND:?SIP_COMMAND is required}"
    --encoder ./encode
    --baud "${BAUD_RATE:-300}"
    --margin "${MARGIN:-40}"
)

if [[ "${SPEAK:-0}" == "1" || "${SPEAK:-}" == "true" ]]; then
    if ! command -v espeak-ng >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "Error: SPEAK is enabled, but 'espeak-ng' is not installed in this container image." >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    ARGS+=(--speak)
fi

if [[ -n "${SPEECH_LANG:-}" ]]; then
    ARGS+=(--lang "${SPEECH_LANG}")
fi

if [[ -n "${SPEECH_GAP:-}" ]]; then
    ARGS+=(--gap "${SPEECH_GAP}")
fi

ARGS+=("$@")

if [[ -n "${EXTRA_ENCODER_ARGS:-}" ]]; then
    read -r -a EXTRA_ARR <<< "${EXTRA_ENCODER_ARGS}"
    ARGS+=(-- "${EXTRA_ARR[@]}")
fi

exec ./sip "${ARGS[@]}"
EOF
chmod +x /mnt/server/start.sh

echo "Installation complete."

variables.name: SIP Registrar URI
variables.description: SIP registrar URI over UDP (for example: sip:pbx.example.net).

variables.name: SIP Identity URI
variables.description: SIP account identity URI (for example: sip:1001@pbx.example.net).

variables.name: SIP Password
variables.description: SIP digest authentication password (passed via the SIP_PASSWORD environment variable).

variables.name: Message Command
variables.description: Shell command (/bin/sh -c) executed for each incoming call; stdout (max 7400 bytes, 7-bit ASCII) is encoded and played.

variables.name: Baud Rate
variables.description: PX1000 C FSK baud rate: 300, 600, or 1200.

variables.name: Margin
variables.description: Encoder margin byte, integer from 0 to 127 (default: 40).

variables.name: Enable Speech Intro
variables.description: Read the message aloud before the FSK signal (encode -s). Requires espeak-ng in the container image (not included in the default Debian yolk).

variables.name: Speech Language
variables.description: Optional eSpeak NG voice or language code (for example: cs or en-us) when speech intro is enabled.

variables.name: Speech Gap Seconds
variables.description: Silence in seconds between spoken intro and FSK transmission (0 to 600, default: 3).

variables.name: Extra Encoder Arguments
variables.description: Optional extra arguments forwarded to encode after -- (space-separated).

variables.name: Version
variables.description: GitHub release tag to install (or 'latest'). Set to 'main' to build the latest main branch from source; if no published release exists, the installer automatically builds from source.
